about: Omikuji blessings (加護): the roguelike layer. Drawn during a run from omikuji stands, elite Faithless and boss defeats; they stack until Reimu falls, then all are lost. Effect keys are read by the game; values add up across blessings.

fortunes.text_en: The slip is written in a hand you almost recognise.
An ordinary fortune. Ordinary is a kindness now.
Good luck, later. The slip does not say how much later.
Tie it to the branch and walk away. Or keep it, and keep what comes with it.

elite_affixes.text_en: Twice the poise, half again the health.
Carries a shard of a shrine mirror; ofuda thrown at its face come back. Strike it, or strike from the side.
Bursts into a ring of bullets when it falls.
Fires twice as often, in wider volleys.

blessings.text_en: Each ofuda erases two more enemy bullets before it is spent.
blessings.lore_en: A shrine's first defence was never a barrier. It was paper, and the belief that paper could hold.

blessings.text_en: Gohei swings clear bullets a metre further out.
blessings.lore_en: Hakurei maidens sweep the precinct every morning. The broom learns the motion; so does the arm.

blessings.text_en: Each bullet Reimu erases returns 1 more Spirit.
blessings.lore_en: Nothing thrown into the box is lost. That was the promise, once.

blessings.text_en: Grazing a bullet grants 3 more Spirit.
blessings.lore_en: The closer the danmaku, the truer the dance. Every maiden learned this. Few survived learning it well.

blessings.text_en: Each graze restores 1.5 HP.
blessings.lore_en: A wound that almost happened heals the wounds that did.

blessings.text_en: Ofuda volleys throw two more charms.
blessings.lore_en: Folded twice, a charm is three charms. The gods were never good at arithmetic.

blessings.text_en: Ofuda cost 4 less Spirit.
blessings.lore_en: Written on the backs of old ledgers. The ink of forgotten debts still shows through.

blessings.text_en: Without a lock-on, ofuda seek the nearest foe.
blessings.lore_en: Written for the rite of driving out demons. It does not know what a demon is anymore, only that something must be chased.

blessings.text_en: All of Reimu's attacks deal 12% more damage.
blessings.lore_en: A gohei is not a weapon. Say it enough times and perhaps it will believe you.

blessings.text_en: Max HP +20.
blessings.lore_en: The Wayside God gives what it has. What it has is stone.

blessings.text_en: Max Stamina +20.
blessings.lore_en: Pilgrims who walked the old road came home with stronger legs and fewer questions.

blessings.text_en: Max Spirit +25.
blessings.lore_en: The shrine's well was dug past the water, into something that rises when prayed over.

blessings.text_en: One more gourd draught per rest.
blessings.lore_en: Scraped from the bottom of a gourd that never empties. It empties now. Slowly.

blessings.text_en: Fantasy Seal costs 25 less Spirit.
blessings.lore_en: The seal has been drawn so many times it has worn a groove into the air.

blessings.text_en: For a moment after each dodge, bullets that touch Reimu are reflected back.
blessings.lore_en: Stolen from a mirror that learned to dance. It will want it back.

blessings.text_en: Reflected bullets deal double damage.
blessings.lore_en: An offering refused is an offering returned. Returned with interest, if the refusal was rude.

blessings.text_en: Each bullet Reimu erases restores 0.5 HP.
blessings.lore_en: A clean precinct is a healthy precinct. Every maiden was told this. It was true only for the precinct.

blessings.text_en: Gain 25% more Faith.
blessings.lore_en: Someone, somewhere, still remembers to give a tenth. It reaches you tenth-hand.

blessings.text_en: Once this run, a killing blow leaves Reimu at 35% HP instead.
blessings.lore_en: The slip says: not yet. It is the only fortune ever written in that hand, and it is signed with a name that has been scraped away.

blessings.text_en: Attacks deal 25% more damage and swings reach further.
blessings.lore_en: Someone taught your arms this before you were born. You never met her. Your arms did.

blessings.text_en: Longer reflection after each dodge, and reflected bullets hit harder.
blessings.lore_en: Two mirrors facing each other hold a corridor with no end. Every maiden who ever looked is still walking it.

blessings.text_en: Curse: attacks deal 40% more damage, but Max HP -35.
blessings.lore_en: Sharp things break. That is how you know they were sharp.

blessings.text_en: Curse: gain 80% more Faith, but enemies hit 30% harder.
blessings.lore_en: The donation box is heavy tonight. Something has noticed.

blessings.text_en: Curse: far more Faithless are elites, but erased bullets return much more Spirit.
blessings.lore_en: The Faithless can smell a maiden who still believes. Tonight you smell of it.

blessings.text_en: Curse: ofuda volleys throw four more charms, but Max Spirit -30.
blessings.lore_en: More charms, less belief behind each. The Barrier was built the same way.
